path_semantics: Entrypoint and configuration paths are relative to the corresponding pinned upstream checkout after the TreeBench integration overlay is applied.

upsampling_16x.checkpoint_rule: Use the split-matched upsampling_4x checkpoint without 16x fine-tuning.

spupmd_provenance_v1.additional_requirement: The checkpoint records the self-supervised loss and duplicate-handling policy used during training.

training_comparison_policy.statement: Reported checkpoints use model-specific executed training budgets; epochs and batch sizes are not normalized across architectures.
training_comparison_policy.launcher_policy: run_baseline.py consumes each baseline's verified training_reproduction record and rejects OPEN command provenance.
